title: kaxxa niya duquurinna
intro: safar qemmis kobox xagarih kinnaane yaybulleenim ken alliil ekraaroora qammalsime wayta caylale ellecabo garayte. ta aydaadi ayfaf kassiisi qibaadah cayla kee baad caylih qaku diini saduh yan wak. Ta buttah mistirih addat tan, tama buttah aydaadu Qur'aanak addal tan, inkih tan giclo-abak sugte marah takkaawissah tan.
clues: Nanu kaxxa niya luk sugne, ninni cayla qeedaalisso sinniimil naamineeh, qado, finqah yan hadaf luk safar fan culne.
Ni miraac, kaxxaam kibbiimeh yan, mango mari elle yassakaxxe Qari diggoysaanam faxak sugeeh, Hajj nek xissimte xisneh addat gexaanamih hadaf luk suge.
Xer baaxok, nanu kaxxa cayla luk genne, Qusba Magaalal sugte dumaahi xisne diggosnam dudnaamih kibal luk sugne.
Ni qande gibduk sugte, qaxmeqe gineenit miraacisak sugte, nanu edde wararneh nan baaxoh addal tan ummatta tannah tan gaadih addat sumaqteh sugte.
nanu ninni wadba gufne wak, qibaadah gaba culsa tekke; qunxa, gali le gineenit tumbulleeh, alaysen kallayto xeet nee qidak.
nek inkih tan safar finqak gaba kalti, nek bohoy le cayli amolladih bayteh, qanxixxe qallay innah, nek kaxxa ekraaro qaaneh obte.
arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
